newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign reserves $112.06 bln at end March.
newsitem.headline: China foreign reserves $112.06 bln at end March.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves totalled $112.06 billion at the end of March, the official Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
That figure marked an increase of $7.0 billion compared with the beginning of the year, the newspaper said.
China's foreign exchange reserves reached $105 billion at the end of 1996, up $31.5 billion from the beginning of 1995.
The central bank, the People's Bank of China, has said it expects the country's foreign exchange reserves to grow by at least $20 billion this year.
